name: Alice Evelyn Cavendish
original_name: アリス・イヴリン・キャヴェンディッシュ
source:
“A bird in a cage will not know what to do even after it's set free.”

Alice Charlotte’s twin sister. She trusts only her older sister and rejects everyone else to an extreme degree. Her personality is the complete opposite of her sister’s, and her words and actions constantly cause her sister trouble, though she occasionally confuses her with mysterious remarks. According to her, she apparently wants to help. Alice Charlotte believes she is being abused, but it seems that other people cannot see Alice Evelyn...

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/an/alicenightmare.htm]official website[/url]]
